compatibility.notes: Public display name Triage is independent of canonical asset id agent.triage-to-agent-ready.

do_not_use_when.text: The request already has a single actionable state and an agent-ready brief and only needs implementation
Implementation is already in progress and the next action is to continue work rather than classify the request

use_when.text: A new request has arrived in needs-triage state and must be evaluated against project vocabulary and prior decisions
A reported bug or external change needs the core claim verified before being expanded into scope
A request must be routed to ready-for-agent, ready-for-human, needs-information, or rejected with an evidence-based reason

evidence_outputs.description: Defensible triage state with evidence-based reason.
evidence_outputs.name: classified_state

evidence_outputs.description: Behavioral brief sufficient for autonomous work when state is ready-for-agent.
evidence_outputs.name: agent_ready_brief

inputs.description: Incoming bug, feature request, or external change including discussion, labels, attachments, and any code samples.
inputs.name: request

inputs.description: Project domain language and durable decisions used to interpret the request.
inputs.name: project_vocabulary

inputs.description: Prior decisions on the same concept, including reasons and reconsideration triggers.
inputs.name: rejected_decision_memory

outputs.description: Single actionable state with evidence-based reason: ready-for-agent, ready-for-human, needs-information, or rejected.
outputs.name: classified_state

outputs.description: Durable behavioral brief with summary, current and desired behavior, interfaces, acceptance criteria, out-of-scope, and pointers.
outputs.name: agent_ready_brief

outputs.description: Concept, reason, prior request pointer, and reconsideration trigger when state is rejected.
outputs.name: rejected_decision_record

preconditions.description: The original request, discussion, and attachments are available for inspection.
The project's triage state vocabulary is known or a defensible default taxonomy is adopted.

capability.purpose: Move an incoming bug, feature request, or external change from raw report to a defensible next state and durable agent-ready brief when appropriate.

requirements.description: The request ends in exactly one actionable state with an evidence-based reason.
The core claim is reproduced or refuted before the request is expanded.
Rejected durable decisions include concept, reason, prior pointer, and reconsideration trigger.
